Elements matching CSS id selector are excluded entirely

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<body><div id=\"ad-container\">Buy stuff</div><p>Article text</p></body>", "{\"exclude_selectors\":[\"#ad-container\"]}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
